snippet: On Wednesday, the council will vote on the proposed ordinance to exempt new development from the original ballot measure’s 3% cap on rent increases, effectively weakening the measure. The new exemption was originally proposed by Mayor Melvin Cater last year. The council ordinance is co-authored by three council members — Jost, Anika Bowie and council President Rebecca Noecker
